text:
If you've been out and about this morning, you already know it's a good one, clear and 75 with just a light southerly breeze. That holds until the afternoon window opens up, and between 2 and 5 the sky gets its one shot at showers and a rumble of thunder. Models actually lean drier than the official 40 percent, so I wouldn't cancel outdoor plans, just keep an eye up if you're out past 2. High lands near 81 either way. The lake stays calm through the afternoon, waves a foot or under, wind swinging from south to west as the front slides by.

Once we're through that window, tonight settles into mostly cloudy with another round of scattered showers possible before 1am, lows near 60. Nothing about tomorrow needs a hedge though, Thursday's partly sunny, high near 78, and dry. If you're deciding when to squeeze in that evening walk or paddle, aim for before 2 or after 6, and don't bother packing the rain jacket for tomorrow.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST: BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) -Happy Wednesday! Today features a mixture of sun and clouds, and the chance for a few spotty showers here and there. The best chance of seeing a few of those showers will be mainly across the northern half of the areas and especially out across northern New York. Any rain is very, hit or miss in nature and if you do see any it doesn’t really amount to all that much. High temperatures for the day climb back into the mid and upper 70s this afternoon with a few close to 80 across southern Vermont where they are drier. Any showers wrap up tonight, as skies clear and lows fall into the 50s.
